goal: Evaluate candidate routes from one USD 500 PAPER attempt toward USD 10000 under current user rules.

accepted_user_rules.attempt_end: Zero equity or inability to place a permissible trade with remaining funds; distinguish temporary lack of signal from insufficient funds.
accepted_user_rules.restart: Retain attempt history and residual assets, review and version the strategy before a new USD 500 attempt; count every new contribution.
accepted_user_rules.growth_direction: Reduce risk as capital grows and retain a smaller aggressive allocation; thresholds and weights are unvalidated hypotheses.

historical_rules_not_current_user_rules: Old Codex research peak-equity 40% drawdown liquidation
Claude USD 50 termination and 2x switch thresholds
Main account 10% drawdown shutdown (applies only to its separate owner/workflow)

first_experiment.name: Capital-rule and execution-feasibility replication
first_experiment.execution: Signals only from completed prior bars; next executable open. Record unavailable bars and unfillable orders. Distinguish model stops from broker-supported protection.
first_experiment.changed_hypothesis: Study removal of the historical 40% account termination rule, while keeping signal logic fixed for attribution. No borrowed capital. This change alone is not evidence of better results.
funding_modes: Sequential reviewed attempts with all USD 500 contributions and residual balances counted
before_any_run: Record input source, retrieval time, cutoff, full input SHA-256 and permissible sharing scope.
If the original input is unavailable, version newly obtained input separately; do not claim exact reproduction.
Declare whether the universe is point-in-time; retain missing and delisted cases or disclose inability to obtain them.
Freeze practical whole-share or fractional execution assumptions, minimum size, settlement and account restrictions.
Freeze attempt-end feasibility criteria and any growth-stage thresholds before inspecting new results.
Record every candidate and change; already inspected 2024-2026 data remain exploratory, not unseen validation.

additional_routes_pending_separate_proto: Post-event continuation, with news timestamp and fixed processing delay before executable quotes
Long-option high-convexity hypotheses, including Claude's 0DTE idea, only after contract-universe and historical bid/ask data checks
options_evidence_gate: Verify market-data host binding and entitlement independently of PAPER account authentication; do not copy credentials from another account.
Distinguish OPRA from indicative data; include timestamps, sizes, stale/zero bid, missing quotes and all eligible losing or expired contracts.
Respect whole contracts, multiplier, USD 500 budget, spread, latency and exit liquidity.
Treat expiry/exercise handling and orders as separate execution work; no trade activation in this handoff stage.
Do not label model prices or hypothetical trades as actual FILLs.
required_outputs: Every candidate and failed attempt, strategy version, data cutoff and complete cost assumptions
Per-attempt contributions, residual cash/assets, active equity, retired wealth, cumulative contributions and net profit
Time to USD 1000/2000/10000, full-loss and untradeable outcomes, end-of-sample censoring
Dependence-aware uncertainty; overlapping windows are not independent trials
Comparators, parameter selection history, limitations and questions for peer review
publication: After each completed stage, publish versioned sanitized artifacts only beneath exchange/codex/s500/ on the existing shared branch; preserve failures and supersedes history.
automation: Reuse existing Codex-500 observation workflow; no new scheduler, no changes to the separate main-account automation.
